list.heading: Heading above the role list in the left rail, e.g. 'Roles (4)'. PLURAL on {count} — Polish needs three forms. {count} is already formatted by n(). CSS uppercases it, so give sentence case. Replaces a heading that was split into a word plus a separate '(n)' node.
list.new: Icon button above the role list, and the action inside the empty state. Opens the create dialog. ≤3 words — it is also the button's aria-label and title.
list.unsaved: aria-label and title of the small • dot marking a role with unsaved permission changes. The dot itself stays in markup. ≤2 words.
list.editAria: aria-label of the pencil button on a role row. {name} is that role's name, so the label is unique per row.
list.deleteAria: aria-label of the bin button on a role row. {name} is that role's name, so the label is unique per row.
list.protectedHint: title of the bin button when it is disabled because the role is built in and cannot be removed. No trailing period.
detail.noDescription: Shown in place of the description when a role has none. Not an error — just absent. Rendered in italics. ≤2 words.
detail.modulesHeading: Small heading above the module checklist. ≤3 words. CSS uppercases it.
detail.moduleCount: Fraction next to that heading: how many of the CRM's modules this role may manage. ONE message — never split the fraction. {granted} and {total} are both numbers; PLURAL on {total}, so Polish needs three forms.
detail.grantAll: Text button that grants the role every module. Imperative, ≤2 words.
detail.revokeAll: Text button next to it that takes every module away. Imperative, ≤2 words. The · between them stays in markup.
detail.save: Primary button at the bottom of the detail pane; commits the pending module grants. Imperative, ≤2 words. Was Title Case ('Save Changes') before the migration.
permissions.grantAria: aria-label of one module's checkbox. {module} is a module label from permissions.resource.*, already translated. Says that ticking it gives this role access.
permissions.resource.contacts: Label of the 'contacts' module in the access checklist. The raw token comes from PERMISSION_RESOURCES and stays the value; this is only its label. Noun, plural, 1 word — CSS 'capitalize' was doing this job before and does not produce correct Polish.
permissions.resource.forms: Label of the 'forms' module. Noun, plural, 1 word. Glossary: form → formularz.
permissions.resource.leads: Label of the 'leads' module. Noun, plural, 1 word. Glossary: lead stays 'lead' in Polish and inflects.
permissions.resource.newsletter: Label of the 'newsletter' module. Noun, 1 word. Glossary: newsletter stays 'newsletter'.
permissions.resource.settings: Label of the 'settings' module. Noun, plural, 1 word. Glossary: settings → ustawienia.
permissions.resource.integrations: Label of the 'integrations' module — plugins and outside services. Noun, plural, 1 word. Glossary: integrations → integracje.
permissions.resource.roles: Label of the 'roles' module, i.e. this very screen. Noun, plural, 1 word.
permissions.resource.users: Label of the 'users' module — the member list. Noun, plural, 1 word. Glossary: member/user → użytkownik.
permissions.resource.boards: Label of the 'boards' module (work kanban). Noun, plural, 1 word.
empty.noneTitle: Empty-state title when no role has been defined yet. ≤3 words.
empty.noneMessage: Body under it. One sentence saying what a role is for: handing out permissions.
empty.selectTitle: Empty-state title in the detail pane when roles exist but none is selected. ≤3 words.
empty.selectMessage: Body under it. One sentence telling the reader to pick a row on the left, and what they can then do.
edit.action: Label of the pencil action: its title attribute. Imperative, ≤3 words.
edit.title: Title of the edit dialog. Polish is a noun phrase ('Edycja…'), English an imperative — a heading, not a button. ≤3 words.
edit.description: Sub-title of that dialog. {name} is the role being edited and must be wrapped in the locale's own quote marks (Polish „…”, English “…”). It replaced " entities in the old template.
edit.protectedHint: Note under the name field when the role is built in: its name is fixed, the description is not. One sentence.
form.name: Field label for a role's name, in both dialogs. 1 word.
form.namePlaceholder: Placeholder in the name input of the edit dialog. ≤2 words.
form.nameExample: Placeholder in the name input of the create dialog — an example of a role someone would create. Starts with the locale's 'e.g.' abbreviation.
form.description: Field label for a role's description, in both dialogs. 1 word.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Placeholder in both description inputs. Says the field may be left empty. ≤3 words.
form.nameRequired: Validation error when the name field was left empty. One sentence.
form.nameTooLong: Validation error when the typed name is over the limit. {max} is that limit — never write the number into the message.
form.descriptionTooLong: Validation error when the typed description is over the limit. {max} is that limit — never write the number into the message.
create.title: Title of the create dialog. Polish is a noun phrase, English an imperative. ≤3 words.
create.description: Sub-title of that dialog. Names the three things it does: name the role, describe it, optionally copy another role's module access. Polish stays impersonal.
create.copyFrom: Field label of the select that picks a role to copy module access from. ≤4 words.
create.copyFromHint: Hint under that select: what is copied, and that it can be changed later. Polish stays impersonal — no 'You can'.
create.copyFromAria: aria-label of that same select. Screen-reader only; says what is being chosen.
create.copyNone: The select's first option — create the role with no permissions at all. ≤2 words.
create.submit: Submit button of the create dialog. Imperative, ≤3 words.
delete.action: Label of the destructive action: the bin button's title, and the confirm button of its dialog. Names the action AND the object — never a bare 'OK'. Imperative, ≤3 words.
delete.title: Title of the delete confirmation. A question, ≤4 words. Polish uses the infinitive ('Usunąć…?').
delete.message: Body of that confirmation. {name} identifies the role and must be wrapped in the locale's own quote marks. Two consequences: members holding the role lose its access, and the action cannot be undone.
discard.title: Title of the confirmation shown when unsaved permission changes would be lost — on switching role, and on leaving the page. A question, ≤3 words. Polish uses the infinitive.
discard.one: Body of that confirmation when switching to another role. {name} is the role whose edits are pending, wrapped in the locale's own quote marks.
discard.all: Body of the same confirmation when navigating away from the page entirely, where no single role can be named. Polish stays impersonal — no 'You have'.
discard.confirm: The confirm button of that dialog. Names what happens: the edits go away. Imperative, ≤3 words.
toast.saved: Toast after the pending module grants were stored. Past tense, ≤3 words.
toast.created: Toast after a new role was created. Past tense, ≤3 words.
toast.deleted: Toast after a role was removed. Past tense, ≤3 words.
toast.copyFailed: Toast when the role itself was created but copying the source role's module access failed, and the server gave no reason. Says both halves — the role exists, the copy did not happen.
toast.copyFailedReason: Same situation, but the server did give a reason: {message} is its text, appended after a colon. One message, not fragments.
errors.load: Error banner above the whole page when the role list could not be fetched. {message} is the server's own reason, inserted into the sentence — keep it as one message, never as fragments around the value.
errors.save: Fallback in the save toast when the server gave no message. No trailing period.
errors.create: Fallback in the create dialog when the server gave no message. No trailing period.
errors.delete: Fallback in the delete toast when the server gave no message. No trailing period.
errors.reasonUnknown: Used as {message} in errors.load when the failure carried no server text at all. A sentence fragment that has to read naturally after a colon — lower case, no trailing period.
seed.superAdmin.description: Description of the one role the API seeds on first boot, shown under its name in the role detail panel. The database keeps the English seed and is never rewritten; this key is used only while the row still matches it, so an operator who edits the description sees their own words instead (ADR-0011). A noun phrase, no trailing period — it sits where user-written descriptions sit. The role's NAME ('super-admin') is an identifier and is never translated.
